c1-02-01.title: Communicative Challenge: Compressing a Clause
c1-02-01.scenario: An editor of a journal finds one of your sentences too heavy.
c1-02-01.prompt: Tell the editor which question the committee has been examining for a long time, in one compressed phrase.
cues: Name the agent of the examining
Add how long it has been going on
c1-02-01.target: A bizottság által régóta vizsgált kérdés végre napirendre került.
c1-02-01.english: The question long examined by the committee finally reached the agenda.
c1-02-01.canDo: I can compress a relative clause into a participle before the noun.

c1-02-02.title: Communicative Challenge: Background in One Phrase
c1-02-02.scenario: A tutor asks you why the committee judged the result positively.
c1-02-02.prompt: Tell the tutor the result is good, taking the circumstances into account.
c1-02-02.target: A körülményeket tekintetbe véve az eredmény jónak mondható.
c1-02-02.english: Taking the circumstances into consideration, the result can be called good.
c1-02-02.canDo: I can use a participle in -va/-ve as the background of a formal sentence.

c1-02-03.title: Communicative Challenge: Nouns Instead of Clauses
c1-02-03.scenario: A colleague asks how the reforms will be carried out.
c1-02-03.prompt: Tell your colleague how fast the work goes, depending on something.
c1-02-03.target: A munka sebessége az új adatok függvényében változik.
c1-02-03.english: The speed of the work changes depending on the new data.
c1-02-03.canDo: I can replace a verb clause with a noun phrase such as a kérdés tisztázása.

c1-02-04.title: Communicative Challenge: A Long Noun Phrase
c1-02-04.scenario: A seminar leader asks you to describe a theory in one phrase.
c1-02-04.prompt: Describe a theory that experts have debated for a long time.
c1-02-04.target: Egy sokak által régóta vitatott, mélyreható elméletről beszéltünk.
c1-02-04.english: We talked about a profound theory debated by many for a long time.
c1-02-04.canDo: I can stack several adjectives and participles before one noun.

c1-02-05.title: Communicative Challenge: Sentence Rhythm
c1-02-05.scenario: After reading the text about Kosztolányi, the tutor asks you what it says about the Hungarian sentence.
c1-02-05.prompt: Tell the tutor how the text describes the Hungarian sentence.
c1-02-05.target: A szöveg szerint a magyar mondat nem merev, előre kiszámított út, hanem élő szervezet.
c1-02-05.english: According to the text, the Hungarian sentence is not a rigid, pre-calculated path but a living organism.
c1-02-05.canDo: I can follow a short text about Kosztolányi's essays on the Hungarian sentence.

c1-02-consolidation.title: Communicative Challenge: Rewriting a Sentence
c1-02-consolidation.scenario: Your tutor asks you to make a heavy sentence shorter and more elegant.
c1-02-consolidation.prompt: Say your sentence about a decision with a participle before the noun, and give the background.
cues: Use a participle with by the government
c1-02-consolidation.target: A kormány által elfogadott intézkedések megnyugtatták a piacot, a körülményeket tekintetbe véve.
c1-02-consolidation.english: The measures adopted by the government calmed the market, taking the circumstances into account.
c1-02-consolidation.canDo: I can build participial phrases before the noun with accuracy.
